comment: ANRCETI is an institution, not a named intervention being applied; default for a non-EU finding is unresolved_gap.
As -0048: statement on how the regulator operates, no named intervention; unresolved_gap is the default.
Ministry mandate: under M2 a mandate reads as country_response (as MDA-GOV-2023-001-0146), not implementation.
Public search functions on the CSO register are closer to re-use and transparency (RI-TEC-016) than to register digitalisation or quality (RI-TEC-015).
Awareness and complaint trends name no intervention being applied; unresolved_gap is the default.

E-procurement is one area in a long list of PFM improvements (incidental reference, as the Growth Plan items put out); should be out_of_scope, and nothing in the text supports replacement (RI-TEC-038).
Digitalisation is one aim of a general infrastructure investment recommendation; G4 seed kept, but materiality is marginal.
Records of migrant workers in the Migration and asylum system bear on foreign workers generally; RI-FMW-014 fits at least as well as RI-FMW-002.
Civil service HR systems read as shared administrative systems under RI-TEC-004 only loosely; could be back-office (R22); already flagged.
General statement on digitalisation (e-government, skills, ICT sector), not business adoption; RI-TEC-002 fits as well as RI-TEC-033.
As MDA-EU-2024-001-0034: HRMIS under RI-TEC-004 is a doubtful fit (possible back-office).
Sentence is on internet access and public e-services, not business adoption; RI-TEC-013 and RI-TEC-036 fit better than RI-TEC-033.
A lapsed strategy and absent incident plans are not a legal gap; MEC-12 or no mechanism fits better than MEC-01.
Replacing the e-Integritate asset declaration system is not about use of the interoperability platform; RI-TEC-028 is a loose fit and the system may be back-office (R22).
A planned governance structure does not itself show a coordination failure; MEC-08 is not supported by the item.
The sentence is about delayed approval of a system concept; the interoperability link (RI-TEC-028) comes only from context.
Effect of bilateral agreements for Moldovan nationals abroad; nationals access to EU labour markets is out, kept only via RI-FMW-008.
